This is an IMP-01 architecture probe, not a production coding agent.
Use the NX Spike Workspace tool to read, propose a write, and verify the demo file.
Only the fixed .nx-router-spike/example.txt fixture may be changed.
Report the actual tool result. Respect rejection and cancellation; do not retry a rejected action.
For a credential-free scripted demonstration select an NX Spike model in the model picker.

IMP-01B: select NX Auto (acceptance fixture). Submit /low read, then /high read in the same session. The dangerous operation is a harmless simulation.
